description:
Reverse Collapse: Codename Bakery Portraits Pack

DOWNLOAD LINK [v1.0.1]

A light portraits pack containing characters from MICA Team's Reverse Collapse: Codename Bakery,

added mostly only for your player faction.

Also includes 8 flags from factions you encounter throughout the story.

Should be safe to download and drop right into your modpack. No massive portraits count warning here, it's less than 100 items.

Portraits Preview

"Because it's Operation Bakery", or so they said.

[close]

[close]

Included Contents

Base Pack & FlagsURNC Garrison - Mob Characters Pack

Portraits were sourced from the game's official artworks, and belongs to Sunborn / MICA Team.

1.0.0 - 02/25/26 - Initial Forums Release
